title: Bridging the Gap between Reality and Ideality of Entity Matching: A Revisiting and Benchmark Re-Construction

bias_targets.methodology: Re-constructing standard entity matching benchmarks into open-environment scenarios to measure how standard datasets artificially overestimate model performance due to implicit evaluation assumptions.
Comparing entity matching model performance on standard test sets (where clusters/records overlap with training data) against open-matching test sets containing entirely unseen entities and records.

Dynamically varying the mismatched-to-matched record ratio on test sets (from 1:3 up to 1:100) to evaluate how artificially balanced labels in standard benchmarks conceal the true challenge of real-world entity matching.

Evaluating models on a newly constructed multi-modal corpus (incorporating visual attributes alongside text) to demonstrate how single-modality text assumptions limit and bias the evaluation of entity matching systems.
